mapper.select: SELECT a.id, article_cover, article_title, SUBSTR( article_content, 1, 500 ) AS article_content, a.create_time, a.type, a.is_top, a.category_id, category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.tag_name FROM ( SELECT id, article_cover, article_title, article_content, type, is_top, create_time, category_id FROM tb_article WHERE is_delete = 0 AND status IN (1, 4) ORDER BY is_top DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{current} , #{size} ) a JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id JOIN tb_article_tag atg ON a.id = atg.article_id JOIN tb_tag t ON t.id = atg.tag_id ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, article_cover, article_title, article_content, CASE WHEN ai_summary_status = 2 THEN ai_summary ELSE NULL END AS ai_summary, ai_summary_status, ai_summary_time, a.type, a.original_url, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.category_id, category_name, ui.nickname, ui.avatar, t.id AS tag_id, t.tag_name FROM tb_article a JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_user_info ui ON a.user_id = ui.id JOIN tb_article_tag atg ON a.id = atg.article_id JOIN tb_tag t ON t.id = atg.tag_id WHERE a.id = #{articleId} AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.status IN (1, 4)

SELECT id, article_title, article_cover, create_time FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT article_id FROM ( SELECT tag_id FROM tb_article_tag WHERE article_id = #{articleId} ) t JOIN tb_article_tag t1 ON t.tag_id = t1.tag_id WHERE article_id != #{articleId} ) t2 JOIN tb_article a ON t2.article_id = a.id WHERE a.is_delete = 0 AND a.status IN (1, 4) ORDER BY is_top DESC,id DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, "%Y-%m-%d" ) AS date, COUNT( 1 ) AS count FROM tb_article GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC
